SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_period = 4
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC

SELECT
  d.fiscal_year,
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  SUM(r.net_sales) AS period_net_sales,
  SUM(r.receipts) AS period_receipts,
  SUM(r.units_sold) AS period_units
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON r.store_id = s.store_id AND s.is_current = TRUE
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4 
  AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, s.store_id, s.store_name
ORDER BY s.store_id, d.fiscal_year

SELECT DISTINCT
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  s.open_date,
  s.close_date,
  s.region
FROM dim_store s
WHERE s.store_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2024-07-29' AND '2025-08-24')
  AND s.is_current = TRUE
ORDER BY s.store_id

WITH sales_by_year AS (
  SELECT
    d.fiscal_year,
    s.store_id,
    s.store_name,
    s.region,
    SUM(r.net_sales) AS period_net_sales,
    SUM(r.receipts) AS period_receipts,
    SUM(r.units_sold) AS period_units
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON r.store_id = s.store_id AND s.is_current = TRUE
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4 
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
    AND r.store_id < 900  -- Exclude web shop
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, s.store_id, s.store_name, s.region
),
lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT store_id
  FROM sales_by_year
  GROUP BY store_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fiscal_year) = 2  -- Only stores in both years
),
lfl_sales AS (
  SELECT * FROM sales_by_year
  WHERE store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)
)
SELECT
  s24.store_id,
  s24.store_name,
  s24.region,
  s24.period_net_sales AS net_sales_p4_fy2024_25,
  s26.period_net_sales AS net_sales_p4_fy2025_26,
  ROUND(((s26.period_net_sales - s24.period_net_sales) / s24.period_net_sales * 100), 1) AS net_sales_pct_change,
  s24.period_receipts AS receipts_p4_fy2024_25,
  s26.period_receipts AS receipts_p4_fy2025_26,
  s24.period_units AS units_p4_fy2024_25,
  s26.period_units AS units_p4_fy2025_26
FROM lfl_sales s24
INNER JOIN lfl_sales s26 ON s24.store_id = s26.store_id
  AND s24.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND s26.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY s24.store_id

    SUM(r.receipts) AS period_receipts,
    SUM(r.units_sold) AS period_units
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON r.store_id = s.store_id AND s.is_current = TRUE
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4 
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
    AND r.store_id < 900  -- Exclude web shop
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, s.store_id, s.store_name, s.region
),
lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT store_id
  FROM sales_by_year
  GROUP BY store_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fiscal_year) = 2  -- Only stores in both years
),
lfl_sales AS (
  SELECT * FROM sales_by_year
  WHERE store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)
),
regional_summary AS (
  SELECT
    s24.region,
    SUM(s24.period_net_sales) AS net_sales_p4_fy2024_25,
    SUM(s26.period_net_sales) AS net_sales_p4_fy2025_26,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s24.store_id) AS store_count,
    SUM(s24.period_receipts) AS receipts_p4_fy2024_25,
    SUM(s26.period_receipts) AS receipts_p4_fy2025_26,
    SUM(s24.period_units) AS units_p4_fy2024_25,
    SUM(s26.period_units) AS units_p4_fy2025_26
  FROM lfl_sales s24
  INNER JOIN lfl_sales s26 ON s24.store_id = s26.store_id
    AND s24.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND s26.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  GROUP BY s24.region
)
SELECT
  region,
  net_sales_p4_fy2024_25,
  net_sales_p4_fy2025_26,
  ROUND(((net_sales_p4_fy2025_26 - net_sales_p4_fy2024_25) / net_sales_p4_fy2024_25 * 100), 1) AS net_sales_pct_change,
  store_count,
  receipts_p4_fy2024_25,
  receipts_p4_fy2025_26,
  units_p4_fy2024_25,
  units_p4_fy2025_26
FROM regional_summary
ORDER BY region

WITH sales_by_year AS (
  SELECT
    d.fiscal_year,
    s.store_id,
    SUM(r.net_sales) AS period_net_sales,
    SUM(r.receipts) AS period_receipts,
    SUM(r.units_sold) AS period_units
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON r.store_id = s.store_id AND s.is_current = TRUE
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4 
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
    AND r.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, s.store_id
),
lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT store_id
  FROM sales_by_year
  GROUP BY store_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fiscal_year) = 2
),
lfl_sales AS (
  SELECT * FROM sales_by_year
  WHERE store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)
)
SELECT
  'All Like-for-Like Stores' AS description,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN period_net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS net_sales_p4_fy2024_25,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN period_net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS net_sales_p4_fy2025_26,
  COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) AS store_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN period_receipts ELSE 0 END) AS receipts_2024,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN period_receipts ELSE 0 END) AS receipts_2026,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN period_units ELSE 0 END) AS units_2024,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN period_units ELSE 0 END) AS units_2026
FROM lfl_sales
